Secondary sits after the guest-communication step for readers who have chosen a route. The closing CTA in 'Plan the Celebration' carries the only reassurance line, taken from brand-facts.md: 'The fee is agreed in writing before any work begins.' That line is not repeated as subtext on the primary or secondary CTA, so no subtext is recorded for them.
